name: Bókaháza (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bókaháza (a red and blue shield with scales, a sword and a sheaf of grain) above the name BÓKAHÁZA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
